metadata.title: [CHORE][LOGGING]: Migrate logger.<level>(f"...") calls to lazy %-style across mcpgateway/services/
metadata.author: jonpspri

description:
### 🔧 Chore Summary

`AGENTS.md` says "Lazy logging style preferred", and `#1837` (closed completed Jan 2026) addressed two specific hot paths (`sse_transport.py`, `resource_service.py`). However, the broader `mcpgateway/services/` tree still contains **~1000+ `logger.<level>(f"…")` calls** that #1837 didn't reach.

PR #3202's deep review identified this as project-wide cleanup, with concrete numbers: 133 f-string log calls in `gateway_service.py`, 59 in `tool_service.py`, plus dozens more across the other ~50 service modules.

This isn't strictly a bug (most logs are at INFO/DEBUG and aren't on the request hot path), but:
- Eager `f""` formatting allocates and interpolates even when the log level is disabled.
- It's inconsistent with the documented project convention.
- Ruff G004 / Pylint W1203 catch it automatically; today neither is enabled in the project lint config.

### 📐 Proposed approach

1. Enable `ruff` rule `G004` (logging-f-string) repo-wide, but in `--select` mode rather than auto-fix initially.
2. Run a one-shot codemod via [`flynt --transform-fstrings logging.warning`](https://github.com/ikamensh/flynt) or a custom `libcst` codemod over `mcpgateway/services/` to convert the dominant pattern. Examples:
   - `logger.info(f"Created tool {tool.id}")` → `logger.info("Created tool %s", tool.id)`
   - `logger.error(f"failed: {e}")` → `logger.error("failed: %s", e)`
3. Manually review hot-path / multi-arg cases the codemod didn't catch.
4. Add `G004` to the pre-commit ruff config so new f-string log calls are blocked at commit time.

### 📋 Acceptance Criteria

- `ruff check mcpgateway/services/ --select G004` returns 0 errors.
- `.pre-commit-config.yaml` enables `G004` so regressions are caught.
- No behavioral change in log output (the percent-format placeholders evaluate to the same strings).
- A spot-benchmark on a debug-disabled hot path shows the expected nanosecond-level reduction (or just confirms no regression — this is mostly a hygiene change).

### 🔗 Context

- Precursor: #1837 (closed completed) — narrower scope (`sse_transport.py`, `resource_service.py` only).
- Source: deep-review of PR #3202, item #18 in [PR comment](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/pull/3202#issuecomment-4386420357).
- AGENTS.md "Coding Standards" section mentions lazy logging as preferred.

### 📓 Notes

This is intentionally split out from the PR #3202 work because the surface area (~1000 call sites across ~50 files) makes it a separate review and code-mod exercise, not something to fold into a feature PR.
